summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist as specified. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with the public loader and private _resolve_path helper (standard library only: json, os). Added an explicit import in monai/data/__init__.py. Added a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection with tilde underline under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst. Added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with TestLoadDecathalonDatalist and four tests (test_seg_values, test_cls_values, test_seg_no_basedir, test_seg_no_labels), each removing its temp directory in a finally block. Per instructions, nothing was run or committed; tests are unverified. Line lengths were checked (none over 120). Choices beyond the spec: a non-object top-level JSON is reported as a missing key, a non-list value under the key raises ValueError, and items are shallow-copied.
